categories.title: Solar Sails
categories.intro: [excited] First stop, the Etherium! Every clue is from Treasure Planet, Disney's swashbuckling space adventure.

art.prompt: An old-fashioned wooden sailing galleon with glowing solar sails flying through a golden nebula toward a crescent space station Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Treasure Planet, Jim loves zooming through the sky on this rocket-powered board with a sail
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a solar surfer! [laughs] No helmet? Jim, come ON.

clues.clue: This rebellious teenager is the hero of Treasure Planet
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jim Hawkins! Proof that a troublemaker can become a captain.

clues.clue: This tiny pink shape-shifting blob loves to mimic everyone on the ship
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Morph! [chuckles] Morph, Morph, Morph... he'd copy that answer too.

clues.clue: This cyborg ship's cook becomes a father figure to Jim, even though he's secretly a pirate
clues.reveal: The correct answer is John Silver! [sighs] Half cyborg, all heart... and a little bit pirate.

clues.clue: This Oscar-winning actress voices the cat-like Captain Amelia
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Emma Thompson! A captain with a stiff upper lip and nine lives.

categories.title: Space Rangers
categories.intro: [mischievously] Now, a mission for true Space Ranger cadets. These clues are all about Lightyear!

art.prompt: A sleek white and green spacecraft streaking past a hostile alien jungle planet with giant vines, hyperspace streaks of light Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Lightyear, Buzz proudly serves in this elite corps of space heroes
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Space Rangers! [laughs] Buzz Lightyear, Space Ranger, reporting for duty.

clues.clue: This actor voices Buzz in the 2022 film Lightyear
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chris Evans! From Captain America to Space Ranger. Not bad.

clues.clue: Buzz's robot-armored enemy in Lightyear turns out to be an older version of Buzz using this name
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Zurg! Spoiler alert... he IS your future.

clues.clue: Buzz's best friend and fellow commander, who grows older while he tests hyperspeed fuel
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alisha Hawthorne! [sighs] Every time Buzz blinked, years flew by.

clues.clue: Buzz and his crew are marooned on this hostile planet at the start of Lightyear
clues.reveal: The correct answer is T'Kani Prime! [chuckles] Lovely place... if you like killer vines.

categories.title: Tomorrowland and Beyond
categories.intro: [excited] Real photos from the parks! Name these out-of-this-world attractions.

clues.clue: On this Magic Kingdom ride, you fire laser cannons at Zurg's robots and rack up points

accept: guardians of the galaxy cosmic rewind

categories.title: Wish Upon a Star
categories.intro: [whispers] Look up... way up. These clues are written in the stars.

art.prompt: A single bright wishing star above a sleeping village window at night, a telescope on the sill and a sky full of constellations Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Pinocchio, Geppetto makes his wish for a real boy on this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a wishing star! [sighs] When you wish upon a star... it really works.

clues.clue: In The Lion King, Mufasa tells young Simba that the great kings of the past look down on them from these
